archetypes.name: dyn-marker-contract
archetypes.rationale: Shared marker regex and empty-block routing are easy to get subtly wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect issue_wire.named_block_marker_re and its reuse in _line_is_marker, learn_from_bugs boundary cutting, and design_router already-planned detection. Confirm horizontal-only whitespace, MULTILINE search semantics, case sensitivity, and that empty valid blocks route as planned via is not None rather than truthiness. Check split-line and prose-embedded markers cannot match. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
